description: Partner tree node detail navigation interface with tabs for managing specific organizational hierarchy nodes. Provides organized access to partner tree details and analytics data.

pages.name: PartnerTreeViewComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing and managing the details of a specific organizational node within the partner hierarchy. It provides a comprehensive overview, allowing users to navigate through different aspects of the node, such as its core details, relationships, and associated analytics.

buttons.label: Edit
buttons.description: Opens a dialog to modify the details of the current organizational node, including its name, properties, and hierarchical position within the partner tree.
when_to_use: When you need to modify organizational node details, relationships, or hierarchical positioning

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure where to find specific information, use the tabs (if available) to navigate between different aspects of this organizational node. The 'Edit' button allows you to modify the tree structure. For general organizational information, look for a 'Details' tab, and for performance metrics, check for a 'Dashboard' or 'Analytics' tab.
common_tasks: Viewing tree node details: Click on the 'Details' tab (if available) to see organizational information.
Editing tree structure: Click the 'Edit' button to modify organizational hierarchy.
Accessing analytics: Switch to the 'Dashboard' tab (if available) to view performance and data metrics.
Managing relationships: Use the details view to understand parent-child relationships.
Navigating hierarchy: Use the navigation breadcrumb (if present) to move between different levels of the partner tree.
help_guidance.getting_started: To get started, select a partner tree node from the main tree view. This page will then display its specific details. Begin by reviewing the 'Details' tab for core information, and use the 'Edit' button if you need to make any changes to the node's properties or its place in the hierarchy.
